_doc.description: This file documents the two JSON formats accepted by the Singulari News agent.
_doc.placement: Drop .json files into agent/data/queue/ and the agent will pick them up automatically.
notes: published_at must be an ISO 8601 datetime string (UTC recommended).
content should have at least 3 sentences so the AI summarizer has enough material.
category_slug is optional — the agent classifies automatically via keyword scoring.
Remove _doc and _comment keys before dropping real articles into the queue.

single_article_example.title: Example Article Title Goes Here
single_article_example.content: This is the first sentence of the article body providing the main fact. The second sentence expands on the context and gives background information relevant to the story. A third sentence adds a supporting detail, quote, or data point that enriches the summary the AI will generate.

_comment_format_2: FORMAT 2 — batch of articles (array). All articles in the array are published to the queue before the file is moved to processed/.

batch_articles_example.title: First Article in the Batch
batch_articles_example.content: Opening sentence of the first article. Second sentence adds detail. Third sentence wraps up the key point.

batch_articles_example.title: Second Article in the Batch
batch_articles_example.content: Opening sentence of the second article. This sentence provides context and background. The final sentence includes a relevant statistic or quote.
